title: embCAB and ethambutol
dek: EmbB codon 306 is the famous residue; ethambutol DST is historically noisy. Catalogue-grade the allele. Do not let a lineage synonymous embB SNP flip the column.
story: Ethambutol inhibits arabinosyltransferases of the embCAB operon, clinically dominated by EmbB. The codon 306 cluster (M306V/I/L) is the canonical resistance-associated set; other EmbB and EmbC/A changes exist and are graded with more humility.

Phenotypic EMB DST has always been a noisy CC on overlapping MIC densities. Genotype–phenotype discordance is therefore expected more often than for RIF S450L. A genomics lab that reports “EMB-R” from any embB missense versus H37Rv is doing phylogeny, not DST.

EMB is a companion that protects against resistance while INH/RIF/PZA work. Losing EMB is not losing the sterilizing core — but it is losing a guardrail, and in some 9-month DR recipes EMB is still counted. Grade it; do not over-count it.
deep: embC-embA-embB are co-transcribed. Intergenic embC-embA mutations appear in some catalogues.
Optic neuropathy is the monitoring tax, not a resistance mechanism.
Lineage-informative embB SNPs must be subtracted using the catalogue’s not-associated list.
If M306V is present and MGIT says S, believe that you are in the noisy CC zone; do not delete M306V from next week’s prior.

visual.caption: embB hotspot at codon 306, with the rest of EmbB as a longer, quieter tail. This is not pncA-level scatter, and it is not rpoB-level certainty.

example.title: embB synonymous flag
example.setup: A pipeline reports EMB-R because embB differs from H37Rv. The variant is synonymous and lineage-associated. M306 WT.

steps.title: Look at 306
steps.body: If M306 is wild type and no graded missense exists, do not flip EMB.

example.takeaway: EmbB DST is graded alleles, especially 306 — not H37Rv identity.
